response.sql:
WITH grouped_by_status AS (
  SELECT
    sites.healtheval,
    SUM(scans.scancount) AS total_scancount,
    SUM(scans.gbsize) / SUM(scans.spanmin) AS rate
  FROM scans
  INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sites.healtheval
),
average_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM grouped_by_status
)
SELECT
  grouped_by_status.healtheval,
  grouped_by_status.total_scancount,
  grouped_by_status.rate,
  grouped_by_status.rate - average_rate.avg_rate AS rate_minus_average
FROM grouped_by_status
CROSS JOIN average_rate
WHERE grouped_by_status.rate > average_rate.avg_rate
ORDER BY grouped_by_status.healtheval;

assumptions.assumption: SUM(spanmin) is not zero for any status group. Zero denominators would cause division-by-zero errors. If SUM(spanmin) is NULL (all spanmin values are NULL for a status), the rate becomes NULL and is filtered out by the WHERE clause.
